title: Explorer pill
responsibility: Shows a short inline label, such as a state or a count, in the explorer pill style.

inputs.name: Pill.as
inputs.description: Optional semantic element. Defaults to span, with li for list items.

inputs.name: Pill.variant
inputs.description: Optional visual treatment. Defaults to explorer; compact retains a pill and chip retains the Desktop treatment.

inputs.name: Pill.tone
inputs.description: Optional extra owner classes. Defaults to an empty string.

inputs.name: Pill.state
inputs.description: Optional styling state. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting data-state.

inputs.name: Pill.role
inputs.description: Optional semantic role. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting role.

inputs.name: Pill.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible name. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting aria-label.

inputs.name: Pill.title
inputs.description: Optional native tooltip. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting title.

inputs.name: Pill.children
inputs.description: Required caller content. Rendering errors propagate without replacing or suppressing its values.

outputs.name: Pill
outputs.description: Semantic Pill markup retaining caller content, native accessibility and the selected existing treatment.

errors.name: Content rendering error
errors.description: Errors from the required content snippet propagate to the owner.
